question.text: PMS fee structure under SEBI rules includes which of these CAPS?

answer.text: 0.50% cap on operating expenses + exit load structure (3%/2%/1% for Yr 1/2/3)

explanation.text: The Logic: PM Regs: operating expenses capped at 0.50% of daily average AUM; exit load structure limited to 3%/2%/1% across first three years max. The Trap: Management fees themselves aren't hard-capped; performance fees subject to HWM/Hurdle rules. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A explicitly tests; XXI-B expects recall. Manager's Pro-Tip: Always present the fee waterfall in the MITC — clients should see the path from gross to net.
